## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag breaks the project's CLI-flag policy: `--exclude` does not take its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, so CI cannot set it. This should be fixed before merge.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option. `collect` uses it to skip files whose basename matches any of the patterns, and logs each skipped path. The change also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds tests for parsing, filtering and end-to-end archiving.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the --exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — When CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and runs `archive src`, nothing is excluded because the default is hard-coded to `default=[]`. This breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines that set options through the environment cannot use the new flag, and their archives silently include files they meant to exclude. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, choose a separator for multiple patterns, and document the variable in the `docs/flags.md:7` row.
